dedupe_keys.name: cordex coordinated regional climate downscaling experiment regional climate model projections for domains worldwide via esgf

description: CORDEX, the Coordinated Regional Climate Downscaling Experiment of the World Climate Research Programme, coordinates regional climate model (RCM) simulations that downscale global climate projections over defined domains around the world. There is no central CORDEX archive: CORDEX-CMIP5 output is distributed through the Earth System Grid Federation (ESGF), whose index nodes at SMHI-NSC, DKRZ, BADC and IPSL support CORDEX search facets such as domain, driving model and downscaling realisation, and also through impact portals, regional data portals and services of individual institutes, with bias-adjusted RCM data listed separately. Coverage: CORDEX domains on every continent; the site lists the simulations available per domain. For the new CORDEX-CMIP6 round, version 3 of the archiving specifications for dynamical downscaling was released on 27 May 2026 ahead of publication in ESGF Next Generation, and the CMIP6 access pages are under construction. Format and access: model output files downloaded from ESGF nodes; free. Licence: each simulation is marked for unrestricted or non-commercial use in the CORDEX RCM list, and users must check the terms of use before download. Caveats: simulations differ in models, resolution and bias; some older simulations are only in regional portals. Simulation uses: regional climate projections of temperature, precipitation and wind for climate adaptation and hazard exposure studies of infrastructure. Related records: the Nile Basin CORDEX database (data-nbi-nile-basin-cordex-climate-change-database) is a regional portal of CORDEX data, and CMIP6 projections in the Copernicus Climate Data Store (data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds) are the global counterpart.
